2a-11. **R21 DIAGNOSED (read-only Opus job, areas\R21_MOVE_UNDO_DIAGNOSIS_30OCT.md, 04:25; commit 5888ee75, the same as the installed 3.0.86; not yet proved by the X-starts): it is NOT a C-76 regression and NOT the pit-stealing fault (BUG-1227); it is an OLD fault.** CE keeps one pit and pipe list in memory, the one for the drawing it started with. When that drawing is closed and opened again in the same AutoCAD, CE does not load the new copy's list until some CE command that draws or edits runs. CDCHECK only reads, so it runs with no list: every pipe shows as an unnamed pipe, every pit loses its name (P3 shows as a long ID), and about 40 pit-to-pipe joins read "Unresolved" (the real drawing gives 179 Connected and 4 Unresolved; the second open gives 142 and 44). The same 142 and 44 appear in robot runs on 3.0.73 (24 Oct), 3.0.78, 3.0.79, 3.0.80 and 3.0.83, always the second CDCHECK in one AutoCAD start, a different case each time, never connected before. **Drawing data is safe:** CDCHECK writes nothing, and the answer is only wrong until any CE drawing command (PIT, PIPE, EDIT and so on) runs. **Real-job risk for the pilot:** open a drawing, close it, reopen it, type CDCHECK first: you see about 44 false problems. CE 01 drafts a fix design before the 06:00 cut; it needs a BUG number (CE 05) and a line on page 04 until fixed ("after reopening a drawing, run any CE drawing command, or CDSYNC, before CDCHECK"). R21 stays unaccepted on 3.0.86 until the X-starts and a fix. **I report to CE 00 now that this is a pilot-risk addition, not a C-76 regression.**

## 7. Re-test rules and capacity
0. **STANDING RE-TEST RULE FOR EVERY INSTALL (Tim: "thats should be the plan throughout as a rule", CE 00 Rule 14 in CE_SESSIONS_MAP_29OCT.md; first decided overnight 29 Oct, "do your recommendation"; decisions\2026-10-29_TIM_RETEST_RULE.md items 9 to 12; status 22:46). It replaces my FULL-class wording below from C-77 on.** From C-77: CE 02 places every changed file in a tool area and re-tests only what the train touches, plus a small smoke set for each shared file touched; everything else is recorded "carried from <build>" (the 3.0.86 passes carry for untouched areas). Unknown or unmapped files no longer force a full re-test once CE 02 places them in an area. **Kept:** the weekend full re-tests (Sat 31 Oct, Sat 7 Nov, as planned) and ONE full re-test before Max, by Fri 13 Nov. Tonight's running pass is unchanged. Tim's reason (23:10): "why do things need to repass surely if code is not modified and worked on previous versions it counts as accepted or surely we redo these checks at the end... it feels like were going in circles". **Effects (my reading, CE 01 and CE 02 are revising their timelines):** a C-77 install on Friday needs a short targeted re-test, not 8 h 15 min, which frees Friday evening for Codex looks and the C-76 second passes and lifts the numbers Saturday; the old "any FULL-class install voids the full pass" rule no longer drives the calendar, but the full re-test before Max (Fri 13 Nov or earlier) is the one that counts for the pilot build; the likely last full-class install date (Mon 9 Nov) is now a preference, not a hard stop. Question 12 / item 61 is closed; do not ask Tim again.
